request.message: I smell burning from the outlet behind the fridge

events.message: ⚠️ This could be dangerous. If a smoke alarm is sounding or you see smoke or fire, get everyone out, don't go back in, and call 911 from outside. Don't try to put it out with water: water makes electrical and grease fires worse. If it's only a burning smell and it's safe to do so, turn off the appliance's breaker and don't use it again. Then contact your landlord or a licensed professional. HomeFix won't give repair steps for this situation.
